```{r load}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| warning: false

library(sirfunctions)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(cowplot)

# Change if creating report using previous run or new run
use_cache <- FALSE

# Change as needed. Only works for new runs
end_date <- ceiling_date(Sys.Date() %m-% months(1), unit = "month") %m-% days(1)

if (use_cache) {
  if (!dir.exists("data_cache")) {
    dir.create("data_cache")
  }
  
  if (length(list.files("data_cache")) == 0) {
    cli::cli_alert_warning("No data found in cache. Performing a new run.")
    source("generate_data_for_report.R")
  } else {
    load("data_cache/cache.rda")
  }
} else {
  source("generate_data_for_report.R")
}

```

::: panel-tabset

## Overview
End date used for the report is `r end_date`.

The objective of the monthly SG Monitoring Report is as an early indicator warning
for potential disruption in the surveillance system. Indicators are at the country level. 
It is divided into three sections:

**Tile Plots**

The Tile Plots provide a system-wide view for various AFP, ES, and lab indicators
across a region. It is a way to quickly sift through countries that are below the 
surveillance targets.

**Graphs**

The Graphs tab provides a country-level view for various AFP, ES, and lab indicators. 
It is meant to show trends in indicator performance across a temporal scale.

**Detailed Tables**

The Detailed Tables tab presents the data sources used to create the figures in this report.
They are summary table based on available data obtained from POLIS.

**Notes on Lab Data**

Lab data is updated quarterly, hence end dates may not be the same as the end date used in the report.

## Tile Plots

```{r tile-colors}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

#Shared for all tile plots
cat_colors <- c(
        "On target" = "#0070c0",
        "Below target" = "darkorange",
        "To Be Determined" = "lightgrey"
)

# Create a stepped colorscale for values 1, 2, 3
colorscale <- list(
  list(0.0000, as.character(cat_colors["To Be Determined"])),
  list(0.3333 - 1e-6, as.character(cat_colors["To Be Determined"])),
  list(0.3333, as.character(cat_colors["Below target"])),
  list(0.6666 - 1e-6, as.character(cat_colors["Below target"])),
  list(0.6666, as.character(cat_colors["On target"])),
  list(1.0000, as.character(cat_colors["On target"]))
)
```

```{r tile-legends}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 3.5
#| fig.height: 0.55

legend_col <- c(
        "On target" = "#0070c0",
        "Below target" = "darkorange",
        "No data" = "lightgrey")

tile_legend <- dplyr::tibble(
  placeholder = rep(1, 3),
  cat = names(legend_col)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cat = factor(cat, levels = names(legend_col), ordered = TRUE))

tile_plot_legend <- ggplot(tile_legend) + 
  geom_col(aes(x = cat, y = placeholder, fill = cat)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = legend_col, name = "Performance") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = unit(8, "pt"),
        legend.key.height = unit(8, "pt"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

tp_legend <- get_legend(tile_plot_legend)

ggdraw(tp_legend)
```

### AFP Indicators

```{r afp-tile-plot}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

shared_afp_tile_data <- afp_tile_plot_data |>
    mutate(
    value = factor(value, levels = c("To Be Determined", "Below target", "On target")),
    value_num = as.integer(value)) |>
  SharedData$new(key = ~whoregion)

filter_select("afp-tile-plot", "Region: ",

              multiple = FALSE,

    type = "heatmap",

    colorscale = colorscale,

    text = paste0("<b>AFP Indicators</b>"),
    showgrid = TRUE,
    gridwidth = 2,

    xanchor = "left"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "trace"),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    margin = list(t = 50)
         )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

year_cur <- paste("Year", year(end_date))
month_cur <- paste(month(lubridate::as_date(end_date), label = TRUE), year(end_date))
month_prev <- paste(month(lubridate::as_date(end_date) %m-% months(1), label = TRUE), year(end_date))
qtr_prev <- quarter(as.Date(end_date)) - 1
if (qtr_prev == 0) {
  qtr_prev <- paste("Quarter 4", year(lubridate::as_date(end_date)) - 1)
} else {
  qtr_prev <- paste("Quarter", qtr_prev, year(lubridate::as_date(end_date)))
}

cur_compared_to_prev_mo <- paste0(month_prev, " - ", month_cur)

```

#### Indicator definitions

**Number of AFP cases reported:** Number of AFP cases reported the month before the end date compared to the median AFP cases reported from the previous three years. On target if the number of AFP cases reported is within two median absolute deviations of the three-year median. *Timeframe:* `r paste(month(lubridate::as_date(end_date) %m-% months(1), label = TRUE), year(end_date))`

**Proportion 60-day follow-up done:** Proportion of 60-day follow-up done from the previous quarter compared to the same period last year. On target if there is a less than 80% decrease in 60-days follow-up done. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Proportion inadequate cases classified:** Proportion of inadequate cases older than 90 days have a classification from the previous quarter compared to the same period last year. On target if there is a less than 80% decrease in inadequate cases classified. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Proportion lab pending:** Proportion of AFP samples pending in lab older than 90 days. On target if less than 10% samples older than 90 days are lab pending. *Timeframe:* None.

**Timely AFP WPV/VDPV detection:** Median timeliness of WPV/VDPV AFP samples from collection to notification to HQ. Targets are 35 if country has  sequencing capacity or 46 if shipped for sequencing. On target if previous quarter meets these targets. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Timely detection of negative AFP samples:** Median timeliness of negative AFP samples from collection to final culture results. Targets are 28 if country has  full lab capacity or 32 if not. On target if previous quarter median timeliness meets these targets. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Timely stool shipment:** Median days from collection to shipment to lab. Timely if median is less than or equal to 3 days for in-country culture/ITD and 7 days for international culture/ITD. On target if the previous month from the end date meets these timeliness targets. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

#### Indicator definitions
**Median number of collections among ES active sites:** Median collections for operational sites from current month compared to the previous month. On target if median collections from the end date month stays the same or increase compared to the previous month. *Timeframe:* `r cur_compared_to_prev_mo`

**Proportion operational ES sites:** Proportion of operational sites for the end date month compared to the same month last year. On target if decrease is less than 20%. Operational sites are defined as sites with at least 3 collections over the past 
12-month rolling period.  *Timeframe:* `r month_cur`

**Timeliness of ES shipment:** Median days between collection to arrival in lab for an ES sample. Targets depend on whether countries ship samples internationally or in-country. Timely if received within 3 days for in-country lab and 7 days for international lab. On target if median timeliness is less than or equal to these targets. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

**Timeliness of ES WPV/VDPV detection:** Median days between collection to notification to HQ for an ES WPV/VDPV sample. Targets depend on whether countries ship samples internationally or in-country. Timely if reported within 35 days for in-country lab and 46 days for international lab. On target if median timeliness is less than or equal to these targets.*Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

#### Indicator definitions

**Timeliness of virus isolation:** Median days between received in lab to virus 
isolation results (days.lab.culture). Target is 14 days. On target if median day for the current year
is less than or equal to 14 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Timeliness of ITD results:** Median days between virus isolation results to ITD results (days.culture.itd). 
Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Timely lab processing:** Median days from sample received in lab to culture results. On target if previous month median is less than or equal to 14 days. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

**Timeliness of shipment for sequencing:** Median days between ITD results to arrival at the sequencing lab (days.seq.ship). Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Lab workload:** Number of samples received in the culturing lab. On target if less than a 30% decrease in the previous month compared to the same month a year before. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`


**Timely lab processing:** Median days from sample received in lab to culture results. On target if previous month median is less than or equal to 14 days. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

**Timeliness of sequencing results:** Median days between receipt from sequencing lab to sequencing results. Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

:::

#### Number of AFP cases reported

```{r afp-case-reported-graph}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Graph
shared_afp_cases_reported <- afp_cases_reported |>
  dplyr::rename(
      Region = "whoregion",
      Country = "place.admin.0",
      Month = "month") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE)) |>
  SharedData$new()

filter_select("country-afp-case-report", "Country: ", shared_afp_cases_reported,
              ~Country, 
              multiple = FALSE,
              allLevels = FALSE)

plot_ly(shared_afp_cases_reported, colors = c("lightsteelblue", "steelblue")) |>
    add_trace(
    x = ~Month,
    y = ~get(names(afp_cases_reported)[5]),
    error_y = ~list(array=get(names(afp_cases_reported)[8]) * 2, color = '#000000'),
    type = "bar",
    name = names(afp_cases_reported)[5],
    color = as.factor(names(afp_cases_reported)[5])
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    x = ~Month,
    y = ~get(names(afp_cases_reported)[9]),
    type = "bar",
    name = names(afp_cases_reported)[9],
    color = as.factor(names(afp_cases_reported)[9])
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE) |>
  layout(title = list(
    text = paste0("<b>Monthly AFP Cases Reported</b>",
                  "<br>","<sup>Error bars represent 2 median absolute deviation (MAD)</sup>"),
    x = 0,
    xanchor = "left"),
    yaxis = list(title = "AFP Cases Reported"),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h",
                           xanchor = "center", 
                           x = 0.5,
                           y = -0.2),
    margin = list(t = 50)
         )
```

#### Proportion of 60 days follow-up done

```{r afp-60-day-follow-up}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Graph
regex_exp <- "(?<=\\()\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?=%\\))"
shared_prop_60 <- prop_60 |>
  dplyr::mutate(quarter = factor(quarter, ordered = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(dplyr::recode,
                ctry = "Country",
                quarter = "Quarter",
                semester = "Semester",
                month = "Month",
                comparison = "Difference",
                trend = "Trend") |>
  dplyr::mutate(prop_prev = as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(!!dplyr::sym(names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60)) - 1]),
                                                            regex_exp)),
                prop_cur = as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(!!dplyr::sym(names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60))]),
                                                           regex_exp))) |>
  dplyr::select(Country, Quarter, 6:9) |>
  SharedData$new()

filter_select("country-afp-prop-60", "Country: ", shared_prop_60,
              ~Country, 
              multiple = FALSE,
              allLevels = FALSE)

plot_ly(shared_prop_60, colors = c("lightsteelblue", "steelblue")) |>
    add_trace(
    x = ~Quarter,
    y = ~prop_prev,
    type = "bar",
    text = ~get(names(prop_60)[6]),
    textposition = 'outside',
    name = names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60)) - 1],
    color = as.factor(names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60)) - 1])
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    x = ~Quarter,
    y = ~prop_cur,
    type = "bar",
    text = ~get(names(prop_60)[7]),
    textposition = 'outside',
    name = names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60))],
    color = as.factor(names(prop_60)[length(names(prop_60))])
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = TRUE) |>
  layout(title = list(
    text = paste0("<b>Proportion of 60 Days Follow-Up Done</b>"),
    x = 0,
    xanchor = "left"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Proportion with Follow Up", range = c(0, 100)),
    xaxis = list(title = "Quarter"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h",
                           xanchor = "center", 
                           x = 0.5,
                           y = -0.2),
    margin = list(t = 50)
         )
```

### Lab Surveillance Indicators

`{r} max_date_notif` Timeliness is expressed in median days for each interval.

::: panel-tabset

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

culture_lab_intervals <- culture_lab_intervals |>
    dplyr::mutate(`Target Days` = dplyr::case_when(
      interval == "days.lab.culture" ~ 14, 
      interval == "days.culture.itd" ~ 7,
      interval == "days.seq.ship" ~ 7)
    ) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(recode,
                     culture.itd.lab = "Culture/ITD Lab",
                     comparison = "Difference",
                     prop_diff = "Difference, %",
                     trend = "Trend")

interval_summary <- culture_lab_intervals |> 
    dplyr::filter(interval == "days.lab.culture") |>
    dplyr::select(-interval) |>
  dplyr::arrange(`Culture/ITD Lab`)

top_10 <- interval_summary |> 
  filter(Trend == "Increase") |> 
  arrange(desc(Difference)) |>
  select(-Trend) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
bottom_10 <-interval_summary |> 
  filter(Trend == "Decrease") |> 
  arrange(Difference) |>
  select(-Trend) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

summary_string_top <- glue::glue_data(
  top_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)
summary_string_bottom <- glue::glue_data(
  bottom_10,
  "{str_to_title(`Culture/ITD Lab`)} ({round(Difference, 1)})"
)

# Combine into a single sentence
final_summary_top <- paste0("The top labs with increased median timeliness compared to the three year median (difference in days shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_top, collapse = ", "), ".")
final_summary_bottom <- paste0("The top 10 labs with the biggest improvement in median timeliness compared to the three year median (difference in days shown) are: ", paste(summary_string_bottom, collapse = ", "), ".")
comparible <- paste("There were", interval_summary |> 
                      filter(Trend == "Same") |> 
                      nrow(), "labss the stayed in the same levels and", 
                    interval_summary |> 
                      filter(Trend == "No data available for both years") |> 
                      nrow(), "labs with missing 3-year medians or 2025 medians.")
overall <- paste0("Overall, ", 
                  interval_summary |> 
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`), 
                           Trend != "No data available for both years") |>
                    pull(`Culture/ITD Lab`) |> 
                    unique() |> 
                    length(), " labs had data in the lab dataset. ",
                  interval_summary |>
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`)) |>
                    select(4) |> 
                    filter(if_all(1, \(x) !is.na(x))) |>
                    nrow(), " labs had medians for the current year and ",
                  interval_summary |> 
                    filter(!is.na(`Culture/ITD Lab`)) |>
                    select(3) |> 
                    filter(if_all(1, \(x) !is.na(x))) |>
                    nrow(), " labs had 3-year medians."
                  )

```

## Indicator Definitions

### AFP
**Number of AFP cases reported:** Number of AFP cases reported the month before the end date compared to the median AFP cases reported from the previous three years. On target if the number of AFP cases reported is within two median absolute deviations of the three-year median. *Timeframe:* `r paste(month(lubridate::as_date(end_date) %m-% months(1), label = TRUE), year(end_date))`

**Proportion 60-day follow-up done:** Proportion of 60-day follow-up done from the previous quarter compared to the same period last year. On target if there is a less than 80% decrease in 60-days follow-up done. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Proportion inadequate cases classified:** Proportion of inadequate cases older than 90 days have a classification from the previous quarter compared to the same period last year. On target if there is a less than 80% decrease in inadequate cases classified. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Proportion lab pending:** Proportion of AFP samples pending in lab older than 90 days. On target if less than 10% samples older than 90 days are lab pending. *Timeframe:* None.

**Timely AFP WPV/VDPV detection:** Median timeliness of WPV/VDPV AFP samples from collection to notification to HQ. Targets are 35 if country has  sequencing capacity or 46 if shipped for sequencing. On target if previous quarter meets these targets. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Timely detection of negative AFP samples:** Median timeliness of negative AFP samples from collection to final culture results. Targets are 28 if country has  full lab capacity or 32 if not. On target if previous quarter median timeliness meets these targets. *Timeframe:* `r qtr_prev`

**Timely stool shipment:** Median days from collection to shipment to lab. Timely if median is less than or equal to 3 days for in-country culture/ITD and 7 days for international culture/ITD. On target if the previous month from the end date meets these timeliness targets. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

### ES
**Median number of collections among ES active sites:** Median collections for operational sites from current month compared to the previous month. On target if median collections from the end date month stays the same or increase compared to the previous month. *Timeframe:* `r cur_compared_to_prev_mo`

**Proportion operational ES sites:** Proportion of operational sites for the end date month compared to the same month last year. Operational sites are defined as sites with at least 3 collections over the past 
12-month rolling period. On target if decrease is less than 20%.  *Timeframe:* `r month_cur`

**Timeliness of ES shipment:** Median days between collection to arrival in lab for an ES sample. Targets depend on whether countries ship samples internationally or in-country. Timely if received within 3 days for in-country lab and 7 days for international lab. On target if median timeliness is less than or equal to these targets. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

**Timeliness of ES WPV/VDPV detection:** Median days between collection to notification to HQ for an ES WPV/VDPV sample. Targets depend on whether countries ship samples internationally or in-country. Timely if reported within 35 days for in-country lab and 46 days for international lab. On target if median timeliness is less than or equal to these targets.*Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

### Lab
**Timeliness of virus isolation:** Median days between received in lab to virus 
isolation results (days.lab.culture). Target is 14 days. On target if median day for the current year
is less than or equal to 14 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Timeliness of ITD results:** Median days between virus isolation results to ITD results (days.culture.itd). 
Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Timeliness of shipment for sequencing:** Median days between ITD results to arrival at the sequencing lab (days.seq.ship). Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Lab workload:** Number of samples received in the culturing lab. On target if less than a 30% decrease in the previous month compared to the same month a year before. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

**Timely lab processing:** Median days from sample received in lab to culture results. On target if previous month median is less than or equal to 14 days. *Timeframe:* `r month_prev`

**Timeliness of sequencing results:** Median days between receipt from sequencing lab to sequencing results. Target is 7 days. On target if median for the current year is less than or equal to 7 days. *Timeframe:* `r year_cur`

:::
